items.acceptance_summary: Implement and verify local deterministic direct and graph execution with typed invocation, providers, authority, limits, artifacts, evidence, verification, assurance, repair, summary, telemetry, persistence and CLI while preserving all explicit non-goals.
items.next_action: Keep the bounded Phase 2 packet frozen; any payload or scope change requires a new evidence, manifest and independent-review cycle.

items.next_action: Keep the bounded Phase 3 payload frozen; any source, test, runtime configuration or scope change requires a new evidence, manifest and independent-review cycle.

items.title: Implement the bounded real Codex capability invocation boundary

items.acceptance_summary: Build and verify one explicitly authorized, exact-fingerprint-bound Codex app-server pilot with dry-run, prepare-only, controlled-real and blocked modes, bounded context, workspace confinement, truthful host causality, receipts, artifacts, verification, assurance, negative pilots, security evidence, independent review and an honest A/B/C support level without arbitrary execution or global mutation.
items.next_action: Keep the exact bounded Phase 4 packet frozen; any broader host, Skill, tool, provider, MCP, Director, distributed or production scope requires a new phase and review cycle.

items.title: Implement the bounded design-director composition pilot
items.acceptance_summary: Run one exact design-director builder through the fixed composition graph, produce a response-derived HTML artifact, capture desktop/mobile renders, verify structurally, obtain a blind independent critique, allow at most one repair, compare against a native baseline and close with exact evidence without global or installed capability mutation.
items.next_action: Keep the exact Phase 5 packet frozen; any source, test, runtime-configuration or scope change requires a new evidence, manifest and independent-review cycle.

items.next_action: Keep the exact Phase 6 packet frozen; any source, test, runtime-configuration, evidence, control-plane or scope change requires a new manifest and independent-review cycle.

items.title: Modernize backend-patterns as a project-local backend-engineering-vNext specialist
items.origin: User-supplied Phase 7 backend engineering modernization pilot specification
items.acceptance_summary: Inspect current/upstream/native gaps, build and validate a project-local backend specialist with typed contracts, deterministic evals/benchmarks and bounded security/migration stops; run a real isolated backend feature through Phase 3 discovery, Phase 4 preflight, real builder, read-only verification-loop-vNext composition, optional independent criticism and at most one repair; regress Phases 2–6 and close an exact packet without global or installed mutation.
items.next_action: Phase 7 closed as PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS/NOT_PROMOTED. Keep the additive package as a P7_LEVEL_B_CANDIDATE; human/release authority owns any promotion decision, with branch coverage, pip-audit and host-load limitations retained.

items.title: Close high-risk residual branches from Phase 7.1 H-01
items.origin: User-supplied Phase 7.2 high-risk branch closure specification
items.acceptance_summary: Reconstruct the Phase 7.1 residual-branch baseline, execute focused high-risk boundary tests and minimal fixes, regenerate exact inventory and traceability, run the full regression/coverage/static/security/pilot/verifier gates, and close an independently reviewed packet. Promotion requires zero material high-risk residual branches and all required gates; this attempt retains H-01 because 493 material high-risk branches remain and the real host cycle is environment-blocked.
items.next_action: Keep the exact Phase 7.2 packet as PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS/KEEP_CANDIDATE_NOT_PROMOTED. Do not promote or create PHASE7.2-FROZEN.md; reopen only with new evidence that closes the 493 material residual branches and removes the fixed-host/scanner limitations.

items.title: Close the final Phase 7.3 promotion risks and freeze the verified candidate packet
items.acceptance_summary: Preserve the authoritative Phase 7.2 packet, freeze the feature surface, capture a fresh branch-aware baseline and final coverage, normalize High/Medium semantics, close all actionable promotion risks, pin the host, execute a real builder-repair-verifier cycle, record security/dependency limitations, regress all prior phases, obtain a fresh independent review and create the exact final packet without migration, production, release or global-state claims.
items.next_action: Phase 7.3 is frozen as VERIFIED_CANDIDATE_WITH_LIMITATIONS; evaluate Phase 8 only under a separate scope and quality bar. Maintain the scanner, host-observability and lockfile limitations, and do not infer production, release or security approval.
